summary: Frontend-only testing of Feature 3/3 'Πύλη Πελάτη' bulk-pay + regression smoke. All acceptance criteria pass: bulk card renders with 3 pre-selected invoices (868,00 €), selection math and toggle-all work correctly, pay button disables at 0 selected. Bulk checkout redirects to real Stripe Checkout (mode=payment) with EXACTLY 3 line items (ΤΠΥ-0003 / ΤΠΥ-0004 / ΤΠΥ-0005) and a total of 868,00 €. Saved-card button is correctly HIDDEN because customer has no stripePaymentMethodId. Save-card flow redirects to a Stripe Checkout SETUP session. Invalid token /portal/INVALID-TOKEN-XYZ returns 404 (Next.js notFound). Mobile 390px: body scrollWidth == clientWidth (390) – no horizontal page overflow; the documents table sits inside its own overflow-x-auto container. Regression smoke on /dashboard, /invoices, /recurring, /settings?tab=b2g after login demo@timologio.gr/demo1234 – all render, no Next.js runtime-error overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: src/app/actions/portal-bulk.ts line 28: 'async function loadContext(token, invoiceIds): Promise<Ctx> {  const db = await getDb();' – the opening brace and next statement are on the same line (cosmetic only, works fine). Consider linting.

startBulkCheckout silently truncates to MAX_BULK=20; if a customer has >20 open invoices the UI total will not match the Stripe total. Consider surfacing a warning in the UI when rows.length > 20 (currently no protection on the client).
